intro.text: A Hallandren baby, gravely ill with deathfever, whose mother brings him to Lightsong's petitions.

items.text: Halan is so wasted that his skin has shrivelled and he is too weak even to cry; Lightsong can see from his faint Breath that he will not live out the day. Frustrated at always having to send desperate people away, Lightsong refuses the mother's plea, and guards lead the two of them out.
